_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Running Broc Data Lab Irish benchmarks…

description: Compares 16 Leinster commuter towns across Meath, Kildare, Wicklow, Louth, Laois, Carlow & Wexford against Dublin Suburbs once CSO 3-bed mortgage repayments, M50/M1/M3/M4 tolls, EV vs petrol/diesel fuel, 52% TaxSaver rail/bus relief, hybrid WFH office days, and annual commute hours are included (commutemap.datalab.broc.fi).

commuteMode.description: Transport mode: "petrol", "ev" (home night-rate charging), or "public_taxsaver" (rail/bus pass).

focusTown.description: Optional town or county to spotlight (e.g. "Naas", "Navan", "Drogheda", "Maynooth", "Bray", "Greystones", "Wicklow", "Gorey").

hourlyTimeValueEur.description: Personal value of 1 hour spent commuting in EUR (default €20/hr; set 0 for pure cash).

interestRatePct.description: Mortgage interest rate % on 90% LTV 30-year loan (default 3.55%).

officeDaysPerWeek.description: Days commuting to the Dublin office per week (1–5, default 3).

taxSaverMarginalRate.description: TaxSaver relief rate: 0.52 (higher band) or 0.285 (standard band).

name: compare_dublin_commuter_towns
title: Compare Dublin Commuter Belt Towns (Broc Data Lab)
